BRIDGE • BREAK • DEFEND

Your bed. Your last chance.

Build across the sky. Break the red bed, then defeat its owner. Your bed brings you back.

A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

Pocket Bed Wars

  1. Move with the left stick or WASD. Hold BUILD near a bridge gap to place wool.
  2. Tap HIT near the red Steve or the red bed. Break their bed, then defeat them to win.
  3. While your bed survives, you respawn. After it breaks, the next death ends the duel.
